subject: Re: Technical demo readiness — vendor portal & calendar conflict
messages:
From: Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@halcyonhealth.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: vendor-portal@halcyonhealth.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Technical demo request — intake steps pending

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the quick responses this week. Procurement and InfoSec asked me to confirm a couple of gating items before we lock a technical demo with our engineering execs:

- Completed vendor onboarding questionnaire (they provided a portal link)
- Signed NDA (we can return a standard NDA or review a redline)
- Basic SOC2 attestation / architecture diagram or a pointer to a security page

We had tentatively penciled the demo for the week of July 5th, but our CTO will be traveling July 1–4 which makes week-of logistics a little tight. If we can get the intake form and NDA sorted this week, procurement said they can try to move the exec slot to July 6th. If not, they may need to push to mid-July.

I attached their vendor questionnaire (partial) — procurement started filling the company details but left the security evidence blank. Can your legal team look at the NDA quickly? Also cc'ing the vendor portal alias so the intake ticket is visible.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm whether Redwood can sign our standard NDA or propose redlines by EOD Monday (6/28)
2) If InfoSec needs any quick evidence, a short doc or link will do (SOC/architecture)
3) Can you offer a pre-demo technical sync (30m) with your SE if exec availability is flexible?

Appreciate it — Elaine

Attachments: halcyon_vendor_questionnaire_v1.xlsx

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Technical demo request — intake steps pending

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear ask and for routing the portal ticket. Looping in Neha (Legal) and Karthik (SE).

Quick answers:
- We can review Halcyon’s standard NDA and get redlines back quickly. Neha, will a 48-hour turnaround work?
- Karthik, I can put together a one-page architecture summary and point to our public security page; will try to add a short SOC note for procurement.

Given the CTO’s travel, sounds like July 6th is our best target if procurement can fast-track the intake. If intake stalls, we should propose a fallback date (July 12–16). In the meantime, would you be open to a 30-minute technical sync the week before (no execs) so we can demo the product and answer architecture questions? That will shorten the exec session when it happens.

I attached a calendar placeholder in case that helps.

Mateo

--
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@halcyonhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Technical demo request — intake steps pending

Hi all — I reviewed Halcyon’s standard NDA (received via portal). A few notes before we sign/return:

- The definition of "Confidential Information" is broad; suggest limiting to information "marked confidential" or that which is reasonably understood to be confidential.
- Add a 12-month mutual carve-out for pre-existing IP (standard for us)
- Remove the unilateral injunctive relief language — propose mediation followed by expedited arbitration (if they insist on injunctive relief we can accept with exact phrasing)

I attached a redline (NDA_draft_redline.pdf). If Halcyon wants rapid turnaround, I can finalize today and send back an executed copy contingent on procurement completing the intake checklist (we need the SOC pointer or equivalent evidence).

Karthik — can you draft the one-page security/infra summary and a small diagram? If you send it to me I can tee it up for procurement.

If procurement can mark the intake ticket as "security evidence pending" and allow the demo to proceed with a pre-demo tech sync, that's the path I'd recommend. Otherwise, we should move the exec demo to the first available slot after July 9th.

Neha

Attachments: NDA_draft_redline.pdf

From: Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@halcyonhealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Technical demo request — intake steps pending

Thanks, Neha — that turnaround is great.

A couple quick updates from procurement:
- We can escalate the portal intake if we have a signed NDA and the security doc by Monday EOD; they will try to lock the exec slot for July 6th but cannot guarantee until intake is complete.
- Our CTO’s travel is fixed July 1–4, so July 6th is preferred. If not, we should aim for week of July 12.

Agree on the pre-demo sync — our engineering manager (not the CTO) can attend the pre-demo, which would be helpful to vet technical depth. Can we do a 30m pre-demo on Thursday, June 30 at 11:00am PDT? If so I'll send a calendar invite.
